name: Martina Curry
source:
Martina Curry is a genius and famous chef from the Magic Kingdom of Zeth. Her meals are so delicious people from all over the continent travel to give a try to the foods she prepares in her food stand "Sakura & Pasta". She's outstandingly talented for cooking and loves doing so with passion. She gets along really well with people that enjoy her food very much. In the non-canon Kichikuou Rance, she formed a solid friendship with Dark Lord Garutia, who visited her food stand every day and cheerfully ate everything she prepared.

Despite the poor treatment of non-mages prior to the Fall of Zeth, Martina was widely respected and beloved for her talent. She's also a very beautiful woman, enough to pose in Zeth's beauty magazine. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Martina_Curry]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
